css-transition.description: A CSS transition on hover/focus/state change.

appear-on-enter.description: Element appears (fade/slide) when it enters the viewport.

scroll-linked.description: Sticky or scroll-pinned behaviour tied to scroll position.

reducedMotionEvidence.note: Read from the mirrored stylesheets' @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) rules. Each section's motion.reducedMotionEvidence says whether its fallback is measured, site-wide, or the contract default.
